summary: This bill authorizes federal research and grants to study how traumatic birth experiences and post-traumatic stress disorder affect mothers, infants, and families, and establishes a pilot program to research the impact of midwife-driven care models on these outcomes.

scores.thoughts: The bill authorizes appropriations for research and a pilot program related to traumatic birth experiences and maternal mental health. This directly involves new government spending.

The primary purpose of this bill is to authorize research and grants related to traumatic birth experiences, post-traumatic stress disorder in mothers, infants, and families, and the impact of midwife-driven care models. This directly impacts healthcare research and understanding of maternal health.
